title: Nissan, Uber, Wayve unveil robotaxi tie-up
title_zh: 日产、Uber、Wayve 宣布机器人出租车合作
summary: Nissan Motor, Uber Technologies and British startup Wayve said on Thursday ‌they will collaborate on developing robotaxis, aiming ‌to roll out a pilot programme in Tokyo by late 2026.
summary_zh: 日产汽车、Uber Technologies 和英国初创公司 Wayve 周四表示，他们将合作开发机器人出租车，目标是到 2026 年底在东京推出试点项目。

title: UK watchdogs press Meta, TikTok, Snap and YouTube to block children
title_zh: 英国监管机构敦促 Meta、TikTok、Snap 和 YouTube 屏蔽儿童

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide, oil climbs as volatility continues amid Iran war
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下滑，伊朗战争期间波动持续，油价攀升
summary: Markets continue to adjust to a fast-moving fiscal landscape dominated by the war in Iran. Oil prices flail in an unstable setting.
summary_zh: 市场继续适应以伊朗战争为主导的快速变化的财政格局。石油价格在不稳定的环境下波动。

title: Salesforce’s $25 Billion Debt Sale Draws Weak Demand on AI Worry
title_zh: Salesforce 250 亿美元债务出售引发人工智能需求疲软
summary: Pricing on the longest part of the deal tightened by just 0.1 percentage point to 1.85 percentage point above Treasuries — while similar deals have narrowed by an average of 0.3 percentage point this year, the data show.
summary_zh: 数据显示，交易中最长部分的定价仅比国债高出 0.1 个百分点至 1.85 个百分点，而今年类似交易的定价平均收窄了 0.3 个百分点。

title: Apple's new lineup: A closer look at the MacBook Neo & iPhone 17e
title_zh: 苹果新产品阵容：MacBook Neo 和 iPhone 17e 近距离观察
summary: Apple (AAPL) unveiled several new devices, including the $599 MacBook Neo, updated MacBook Air and Pro models, and the new iPhone 17e. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley showcases how the lineup adds lower-cost options while refreshing Apple’s laptops with new chips.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 推出了几款新设备，包括 599 美元的 MacBook Neo、更新的 MacBook Air 和 Pro 型号以及新款 iPhone 17e。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 展示了该产品系列如何增加低成本选项，同时用新芯片更新苹果笔...

title: Meta to develop 4 new AI chips. Can it stack up to the competition?
title_zh: Meta将开发4款新的AI芯片。它能在竞争中脱颖而出吗？
summary: Meta Platforms (META) has unveiled that it is developing four new chips — the MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500 semiconductors — to power its AI and recommendation systems across platforms.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms (META) 宣布正在开发四种新芯片——MTIA 300、400、450 和 500 半导体——为其跨平台的人工智能和推荐系统提供动力。

title: Musk is number 1 on Forbes Billionaires List with a $600B lead
title_zh: 马斯克以 600B 美元的领先优势位居福布斯亿万富翁榜第一
summary: Forbes released their updated World's Billionaires List for 2026. All of the top 5 slots were occupied by major tech CEOs, with Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk's estimated net worth taking first place by a nearly $600 billion lead.
summary_zh: 福布斯发布了最新的 2026 年全球亿万富豪榜。前 5 名全部由主要科技公司首席执行官占据，特斯拉 (TSLA) 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的估计净资产以近 6000 亿美元的领先优势位居第一。

title: Richard Haass warns the geopolitical risk tax will burden markets for years to come
title_zh: 理查德·哈斯警告说，地缘政治风险税将在未来几年给市场带来负担
summary: The era of cheap energy and low-risk expansion is over as Wall Street prepares for a market with prolonged volatility.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街为长期波动的市场做好准备，廉价能源和低风险扩张的时代已经结束。

title: Oracle had a great quarter, but falls short in one key way
title_zh: 甲骨文本季度表现出色，但在一个关键方面存在不足
summary: Oracle (ORCL) reported third quarter earnings results on Tuesday that beat expectations.
summary_zh: 甲骨文（ORCL）周二公布的第三季度盈利结果超出预期。
